verdicts.reason: A has no reading order: the body copy sits at the top left, the headline is pushed into the bottom-right corner, the eyebrow floats at the far right, the legal text is as big as the body and sits next to the CTA, the brand bar has been shrunk to a strip under the button, and the logo text 'SOLSTCE' appears clipped.
